pages.text: The tourist track focuses on casual town management. Once your first visitor-interactive building is ready, tourists will arrive the next morning.

$(li)$(bold)Satisfy Tourists$(): Boost Satisfaction, Magic, and Wonder to increase town experience.$(li)$(bold)Deploy Shops & Services$(): Balance $(l:wandscape:building/shop_guide)Shops$(/l) to earn element coins.$(li)$(bold)Build Hotels$(): Keep tourists overnight with $(l:wandscape:building/hotel_guide)Hotels$(/l).
